def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0]) if h else 0
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    divider=next((r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v==2 for v in row)), None)
    if divider is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    sources=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==4]
    for r,c in sources:
        nr=r+1
        if nr < h and r < divider and nr == divider-1:
            out[nr][c]=4
            k=1
            while nr-k>=0:
                rr=nr-k
                if any((sr,sc)!=(r,c) and sr==rr and c-k<=sc<=c+k for sr,sc in sources):
                    break
                if c-k>=0: out[rr][c-k]=4
                if c+k<w: out[rr][c+k]=4
                k+=1
        elif nr<h:
            out[nr][c]=4
    out[divider]=grid[divider][:]
    return out
print('demo checks:', [transform(i)==o for i,o in D])

source='''def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0]) if h else 0
    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    divider = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 2 for v in row)), None)
    if divider is None:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value != 4:
                continue
            nr = r + 1
            if nr < h and r < divider and nr == divider - 1:
                out[nr][c] = 4
                k = 1
                while nr - k >= 0:
                    if c - k >= 0:
                        out[nr - k][c - k] = 4
                    if c + k < w:
                        out[nr - k][c + k] = 4
                    k += 1
            elif nr < h:
                out[nr][c] = 4

    out[divider] = grid[divider][:]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
ns={}
exec(compile(p.read_text(), str(p), 'exec'), ns)
file_transform=ns['transform']
checks=[file_transform(i)==o for i,o in D]
